$reading..validate: newData.hasChildren(['sensor_name', 'flow_rate', 'water_usage', 'leakage_status', 'timestamp']) && newData.child('sensor_name').isString() && newData.child('flow_rate').isNumber() && newData.child('flow_rate').val() >= 0 && newData.child('water_usage').isNumber() && newData.child('water_usage').val() >= 0 && newData.child('leakage_status').isString() && newData.child('timestamp').isNumber()
